nodes.author: fredvries
nodes.text: @Fla_Medic Possibly the result of years of strict lockdowns and reduced social interaction that limited the  spread of many viruses, leaving people (esp. children) less  exposed to common pathogens. Now, many are  encountering these viruses for the first time, creating a 'catch-up' period?

nodes.author: Fla_Medic
nodes.text: @fredvries Distinct possibility. Also, since it is an RNA virus, they can evolve over time, so a new variant isn't out of the question.
